entries.zh: 陆路行粮；备办陆路旅途的粮食
entries.en: provisions for a land journey; to lay in provisions for travel by land
entries.notes: M 栏 tiō（張）作动词「张罗、备办」系推断，路粮即行粮，R 栏空。

entries.zh: 海路行粮；为船舶备办粮食（张罗船粮）
entries.en: provisions for a sea voyage; to provision a ship
entries.notes: L 尾作 p^elmar-（por el mar），与 H「張船」互证，張读 tiō 属推断。

entries.zh: 积储、囤粮（为航海囤积储备的粮食）
entries.en: to lay in stores, to stock up provisions (for a voyage)

entries.zh: 杀、杀死（M 作「刣伊」，即杀他）
entries.en: to kill; to kill him
entries.notes: R 栏作 capslap 不可解，疑为旁注或讹写；L/H/M 三栏意义一致。

entries.en: to kill, to slay
entries.notes: H「殺」与 L matar 明确一致，M 末之 gioso 未详。

entries.zh: 处决、诛杀（处死已判刑之人；M 末混入西语 ladrone 盗贼）
entries.en: to execute (a condemned man); to put to death by sentence
entries.notes: M 栏 sũ tay jo ladrone 夹西班牙语词，句读不全，仅 L/H 可据。

entries.en: to slaughter (animals)
to kill lice
entries.notes: H 栏作「蟈[疑:觸]」字有疑，M 仅存 tã 与西语 piojo（虱）。

entries.en: to exterminate, to put down (evildoers, criminals)
entries.notes: M 栏五音节 hau chāĩ ī chān sī 难以分解，只 L/H 两栏可据。

entries.en: to assassinate one's lord or king; to commit regicide
to kill the king; regicide
to kill with a knife or sword; to slay

entries.zh: 杀牲害命（宰杀牲畜、戕害生灵）
entries.en: to slaughter livestock and take life
to slaughter (animals)
to slaughter in suppression; to exterminate the wicked
to root out and destroy (evildoers)

entries.zh: 气死人（以事务相逼、激怒而致死）
entries.en: to vex a man to death; to plague someone to death with business

entries.zh: 弑君篡位（并及君之嗣子）
entries.en: to kill the king and his heir (by usurpation)
entries.notes: H 首字作「篡[疑:墓]」，L 之 hese 疑为 heredero（嗣子）之略。

entries.en: to usurp the kingdom (by killing the king)
entries.notes: H 首字作「篡[疑:墓]」，篡本义夺位，与 L「matar ael Rey」不尽合，姑从篡夺解。

entries.zh: 毒死（以毒物致死）；L 作「以石击毙」，与 H 不合，原件残损存疑
entries.en: to poison to death; L reads 'matar a pedradas' (to stone to death), at odds with the Chinese column
entries.notes: M 栏含 [残]/T99 污损，tog sy 可读为毒死，其后 tay si iog 残缺难辨。

entries.en: to put the violent to death; to execute robbers
entries.notes: M 栏首音节 [残]（T99），仅存 pō 对「暴」，H/L 尚可定。
